## Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen change, and the pipeline stage or public
interface affected.

## Validation

- [ ] Built every changed source file with a documented profile
- [ ] Ran the relevant CTest suite
- [ ] Ran applicable `--selftest` checks
- [ ] Compared representative before/after metrics or audits (algorithm changes)
- [ ] Ran an install smoke test (packaging/CMake changes)

Commands and results:

## Integration impact

- [ ] No public API or ABI change
- [ ] No canonical artifact update
- [ ] No dependency or licensing change
- [ ] Documentation matches changed commands, defaults, and outputs

If any box above is intentionally left unchecked, explain why and identify the
follow-up work.
